reviews.name: Floor Cushion
reviews.reason: The exact current Floor Cushion reads as a real low round cushion at both detail and Store-card scale: the three-quarter body has visible gusset thickness, rim piping, stitched panels, four tuft depressions and a grounded shadow. Aqua highlights, wave embroidery and restrained pictorial trim carry Aqua Wave without branding; the simpler construction is appropriate for Tier 1. It is visually distinct from the later pod, bean and upholstered-chair silhouettes.

reviews.name: Moon Chair
reviews.reason: The exact Moon Chair has a strongly differentiated crescent-shell silhouette with a deep seat cavity, stacked upholstered back cushions, padded arm surfaces and a grounded bowl/base. Nebula/star shell material, textile cushions and cyan/pink cast lighting create real material separation and a premium Galaxy Glow identity. The crescent remains unmistakable in the staged Store card and materially exceeds a palette-only Tier-4 treatment.

reviews.reason: The exact Throne Chair delivers a clear Tier-5 construction jump: tall architectural back, crown-like sunburst crest, tufted upholstery, rolled padded arms, star medallions, metallic frame and shaped feet all remain readable at Store-card scale. Warm orange/gold upholstery and sunlit metallic response give Sunny Pop a physical premium treatment, while cyan edge light keeps the StarBlox saturated toy-game depth without turning the chair into a flat icon.
